name: 双极磁吹灭弧空气开关款
description: 双极家用空气开关，磁吹灭弧快速分断，短路过载双保护，全规格安数可选

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating bright seamless light screens (#FFFFFF / #EEF1F4 / #F4F6F8 with soft diagonal window-shadow stripes) and deep charcoal #1C1C1E feature screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio key from front-left with soft contact shadow on light screens; moody low-key with controlled rim light on dark screens
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey plinth and white marble pedestal for product stands
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, dark #1C1C1E on light screens and #FFFFFF on dark screens
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line dark icons inside rounded light-grey info cards, tiny tech-blue underline accents
styleLock.presentationRules: DIN-rail module product always upright, stably centered, consistently scaled, soft contact shadow grounding it; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial-grade home-electrical ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, light fog grey #EEF1F4 and deep charcoal #1C1C1E with one tech-blue accent #2F6FE4 and deep red #C0392B reserved for annotation lines only; neutral-cool studio lighting with bright soft front-left key and soft contact shadows on light screens, controlled rim light on dark screens; modern geometric sans-serif headlines; rounded rectangular light-grey info cards with thin-line icons and thin blue divider accents; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the DIN-rail module product always upright, stably centered and consistently scaled; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏承接点击，一秒传达全规格家用断电保护之选
shots.camera: slight low-angle 3/4 view, full module visible, eye-level base
shots.lighting: bright soft studio key from front-left, soft contact shadow
shots.background: off-white seamless #F4F6F8 with soft diagonal window-shadow stripes
shots.textZone: 顶部药丸标签+主标题区，下方一行短副文案
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. E-commerce benefit hero screen: {product} shown as an upright DIN-rail breaker module at a slight low-angle 3/4 view, standing on a matte light-grey plinth against an off-white #F4F6F8 backdrop with soft diagonal window-shadow stripes; bright soft studio key light from front-left, soft contact shadow grounding the module. A small tech-blue #2F6FE4 pill tag at top reading 「{selling_point_1}」, main headline in #1C1C1E below it reading 「{callout_1}」, one short spec sub-line in #4A4A4A. Product occupies 60-70% of the frame, with the upper window-shadow area holding the headline block so the whole frame reads as one complete balanced composition. 2K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand names, no certification marks, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative clutter, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大短路与过载的用电风险，用双重保护对应消解焦虑
shots.camera: two-panel dark storm scene, product inset at lower area
shots.lighting: moody low-key, upper-left directional lightning glow
shots.background: deep charcoal #1C1C1E split into two dark storm panels
shots.textZone: 左上白色标题区，双联面板内两个编号短标签
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point protection screen. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Deep charcoal #1C1C1E background split into two vertical storm panels with dark-blue lightning and rain over a night skyline, moody low-key lighting from upper left; an inset of {product} at the lower area, product and panels together filling 40-50% of the frame. Two numbered circular markers in deep red #C0392B labeled 1 and 2 with short white labels 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」, headline in #FFFFFF at top-left reading 「{callout_1}」, one short white sub-line, the dark sky above holding the headline block so the composition stays complete and balanced. 2K. Negative: no fabricated disaster statistics, no people, no injured persons, no brand names, no extra text, no garbled text, no watermark.

shots.lighting: bright soft top-front studio light, soft contact shadow
shots.background: soft grey studio #EEF1F4 with white marble pedestal
shots.textZone: 左列标题+三行机制说明文案区，细蓝分隔线
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce mechanism infographic. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} upright on a white marble pedestal against a soft grey #EEF1F4 studio backdrop, front 3/4 view at eye level, bright soft top-front light, soft contact shadow; left text column with headline in #1C1C1E reading 「{callout_1}」, three short lines of grey #4A4A4A copy explaining the arc-quenching and fast-breaking principle, thin tech-blue #2F6FE4 divider under the headline. shots.lighting: controlled rim light from upper right plus soft left fill, low-key

shots.textZone: 左上白色标题+一行短副文案

provenance.notes: 源详情长图 10 片切片（800x1200，60px 重叠）提炼；已剥离品牌名与系列名、CCC 认证标、C10 型号标识、二维码、客服引导语；销量口号与分断参数、配线表数值一律改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽位由使用方填写，未虚构任何认证或测试数据。源文件夹名为『五金』，但图片实际内容为断路器，L2 依据图片内容纠正为『电工』。库内已有『热磁脱扣小型断路器』款，本款以双极家用空气开关+全系列规格矩阵（1P~4P 及漏电保护可选、配线指南）定位区分。
